Thanks — attaching sponsor spot and a short spec PDF.

Hi Emma — great questions, thanks for the attachments. We've penciled you in for a latency sweep and a sponsor spot check. Answers inline: 

- Latency sweep: yes — we can run a sweep across eu-west1, eu-west2, and us-east1. Our ops windows below (all UTC): Aug 11 10:00-11:30 or Aug 12 14:00-15:30. Please confirm preferred window and we'll reserve GPU pools and a dedicated encoder for simulcast.
- Embargo: we can hold the recording export with metadata flags that make the combined recording embargoed until a specified date. Legal/internal retention team will apply a publish hold and then release on 2026-09-01. That workflow requires a DocuSign approval for sponsor asset rights; can BrightMedia route that to legal@redwood.com?
- EU registrant release: if Legal wants an extra checkbox we can add a single boolean field to the registration form and surface that to post-event export. Marissa — can you confirm how fast we can push a one-field change to the registration form (and whether we need a new privacy notice link)?

Ben — can you own the sweep config? I'm attaching a short checklist (simulcast-checklist.xlsx) with steps for encoder, RTMP key rotation, and prefix cache warming.

Proposed next steps:
1) Emma confirms sweep window (Aug 11 or Aug 12) and signs DocuSign for sponsor rights.
2) Redwood runs sweep + records timestamps at each ingest/egress hop.
3) We schedule a quick dry-run 48 hours before the event to validate sponsor pre-roll insertion and caption alignment.

Thanks — 
Soojin

Looping in some quick operational notes so we don't miss anything on test day. Forwarded original for context below.

Key action items for sweep (ops):
- Encoder handshake: confirm timecode offsets on both ON24 and Zoom outputs; if >1500ms diff we need to enable jitter buffer smoothing (adds ~200ms).
- Captioning: enable live captions on Zoom input and pull captions into ON24 stream via caption passthrough. Confirm language tags (en-US).
- Sponsor spot tokenization: the platform should stamp a unique spot_id into the recording metadata so BrightMedia's adtech can validate creative integrity. That stamp must survive transcoding.
- Release hold: we will set a publishHold flag on the session asset; Legal will need the DocuSign to flip the flag for release.

Soojin — I can run the sweep if you confirm Aug 12 14:00-15:30 UTC. Also recommend a quick 15-min smoke at 14:00 and the full sweep 14:15-15:15.
